caption: The drawing depicts a woman standing and facing slightly to her left. She is dressed in a richly colored dark pink or magenta gown that has a wide boat neckline edged in gold, elbow-length sleeves, and a layered skirt with gold trim along the hem and the underskirt. Her blonde hair is styled up and adorned with a black ribbon or bow. She wears turquoise earrings and a black choker necklace with a small pendant. In her right hand, she holds a bouquet of blue and green flowers. She wears white stockings and black Victorian-style lace-up boots with noticeable black soles. The figure stands against a plain beige background, with no additional objects or scenery, and the artist's signature, "Anne Calman," appears in the lower right corner.
title: Doll--"Cornelia"
